			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_domestic_weekly = 0.00005 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_autonomy_applied }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme_earned
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_andean_trade_opinion_factor = 0.06 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_andean_research_speed_factor = 0.025 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_andean_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.04 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_domestic_weekly = 0.00005 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member
				has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_chl
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme_earned
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_industry_applied }
				subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_domestic_weekly = 0.00005 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_autonomy_applied }
				subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_domestic_weekly = 0.00005 }
			}
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
			imp_sanctions_calculate = yes
		}
	}
}

	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_weekly_quote_millions = 0.05 tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_weekly_expense_tt }
	custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_programme }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_andean_trade_opinion_factor = 0.06 tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_mod_trade_opinion_factor_tt }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CHL_andean_research_speed_factor = 0.025 tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_mod_research_speed_factor_tt }
	add_to_variable = {
		COLDWAR_CHL_andean_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.04
		tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_mod_education_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt
	}
	add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_autonomy_research bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
}
COLDWAR_CHL_apply_andean_autonomy = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_complete_andean_autonomy = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_autonomy_applied
		add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_CHL_andean_autonomy_research bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
		COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_initialized
			load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_CHL_1970_focus
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_divided_congress
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_copper_dependence
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_rural_conflict
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_inflation
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_specialists
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_long_coast
			COLDWAR_CHL_politics_initialize = yes
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = CHL }
				CHL = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded }
						}
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded
						add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = BOL }
				BOL = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded }
						}
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded
						add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = COL }
				COL = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded }
						}
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded
						add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ECU }
				ECU = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded }
						}
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded
						add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = PRU }
				PRU = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded }
						}
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_seeded
						add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member
					}
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_all = { COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes COLDWAR_CHL_diplomacy_daily = yes }
COLDWAR_CHL_daily = { COLDWAR_CHL_initialize = yes COLDWAR_CHL_politics_daily = yes COLDWAR_CHL_refresh_programmes = yes }
